name: What are the benefits of a detached guest house versus an attached addition for rental income?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of a detached guest house versus an attached addition for rental income?

acceptedAnswer.text: For rental income, a detached guest house generally offers superior benefits compared to an attached addition due to enhanced privacy and independent access. Tenants often prefer the autonomy of a separate living space, which can command higher rental rates and attract a broader pool of prospective renters. A detached unit also minimizes disturbances to your primary residence and can simplify utility metering. While an attached addition might be more cost-effective initially, a detached guest house often provides a better return on investment and greater long-term flexibility as a dedicated income-generating asset.
acceptedAnswer.description: A detached guest house typically offers more privacy and independent access, which can lead to higher rental income and better tenant attraction than an attached addition.
